  "fact_boundary": {
    "scope": "A buying guide about planning a pre-shipment acceptance demonstration for a completed refrigerated truck purchased from China. Evidence supports only specifically attributed historical Truck Home material and manufacturer examples within their stated scope; it does not establish a universal acceptance protocol.",
    "excluded_claims": [
      "A required or universally valid VIN-to-refrigeration-unit identity procedure.",
      "Sensor calibration, logger interval, measurement accuracy, or pass/fail temperature thresholds.",
      "A standardized cargo load, ambient condition, preconditioning duration, door-opening sequence, or acceptance test duration.",
      "Generalized power-mode performance or engine-off operating capability for the offered truck.",
      "Legal, regulatory, carrier, or manufacturer-mandated acceptance responsibilities.",
      "Current production status or availability of any refrigerated truck or refrigeration unit.",
      "Use of source images without documented copyright and license or permission terms."
    ]
  },
  "facts": [
    {
      "id": "F001",
      "statement": "Truck Home's 2019 background article describes a refrigerated truck as comprising a chassis, insulated body and refrigeration unit.",
      "kind": "external_fact",
      "standard_related": false,
      "standard_assessment": "NOT_REGULATORY",
      "quantitative": false,
      "confidence": "SINGLE_SOURCE",
      "scope": {
        "market": "CN",
        "model_year": "NOT_MODEL_SPECIFIC",
        "generation": "NON_MODEL_PROCUREMENT_METHOD",
        "trim": "FAMILY_OR_METHOD_ONLY",
        "powertrain": "NOT_SPECIFIED"
      },
      "source_ids": [
        "S1"
      ],
      "quotes": [
        {
          "source_id": "S1",
          "quote": "构成冷藏车的主要三部分为底盘、上装车厢、制冷机组。"
        }
      ],
      "checked_date": "2026-11-03",
      "buyer_applicability": "Historical background for distinguishing the vehicle chassis, body and refrigeration equipment in procurement discussions; not a technical specification for a particular truck."
    },
    {
      "id": "F002",
      "statement": "Truck Home's 2019 article distinguishes independent refrigeration units from units that rely on the vehicle engine to drive the compressor.",
      "kind": "external_fact",
      "standard_related": false,
      "standard_assessment": "NOT_REGULATORY",
      "quantitative": false,
      "confidence": "SINGLE_SOURCE",
      "scope": {
        "market": "CN",
        "model_year": "NOT_MODEL_SPECIFIC",
        "generation": "NON_MODEL_PROCUREMENT_METHOD",
        "trim": "FAMILY_OR_METHOD_ONLY",
        "powertrain": "NOT_SPECIFIED"
      },
      "source_ids": [
        "S1"
      ],
      "quotes": [
        {
          "source_id": "S1",
          "quote": "独立制冷机组是指制冷机组拥有单独的动力来源，可以独立工作，不受发动机工作状态的限制。"
        },
        {
          "source_id": "S1",
          "quote": "非独立制冷机组，就是机组本身没有动力装置，不能单独工作，必须要依靠发动机来带动压缩机进行工作。"
        }
      ],
      "checked_date": "2026-11-03",
      "buyer_applicability": "A historically published distinction to prompt confirmation of the exact unit and its power arrangements. Do not generalize it to an offered configuration without that equipment's documentation."
    },
    {
      "id": "F003",
      "statement": "Truck Home's 2019 article says cargo temperature needs differ and links those needs to refrigeration-unit power selection.",
      "kind": "external_fact",
      "standard_related": false,
      "standard_assessment": "NOT_REGULATORY",
      "quantitative": false,
      "confidence": "SINGLE_SOURCE",
      "scope": {
        "market": "CN",
        "model_year": "NOT_MODEL_SPECIFIC",
        "generation": "NON_MODEL_PROCUREMENT_METHOD",
        "trim": "FAMILY_OR_METHOD_ONLY",
        "powertrain": "NOT_SPECIFIED"
      },
      "source_ids": [
        "S1"
      ],
      "quotes": [
        {
          "source_id": "S1",
          "quote": "不同货物对于温度的要求并不同，而对应的冷机功率也并不同。"
        }
      ],
      "checked_date": "2026-11-03",
      "buyer_applicability": "Supports discussing intended cargo and its specified temperature needs with the supplier; it does not supply acceptance thresholds or prove any offered unit's suitability."
    },
    {
      "id": "F004",
      "statement": "Truck Home's 2018 article recommends pre-cooling or pre-heating the body before loading; its stated duration is not adopted as a universal test or acceptance criterion.",
      "kind": "external_fact",
      "standard_related": false,
      "standard_assessment": "NOT_REGULATORY",
      "quantitative": false,
      "confidence": "SINGLE_SOURCE",
      "scope": {
        "market": "CN",
        "model_year": "NOT_MODEL_SPECIFIC",
        "generation": "NON_MODEL_PROCUREMENT_METHOD",
        "trim": "FAMILY_OR_METHOD_ONLY",
        "powertrain": "NOT_SPECIFIED"
      },
      "source_ids": [
        "S2"
      ],
      "quotes": [
        {
          "source_id": "S2",
          "quote": "在装货之前，必须先要对车厢进行预冷或预热1.5h左右。"
        }
      ],
      "checked_date": "2026-11-03",
      "buyer_applicability": "Historical background for discussing body conditioning before loading. Do not repeat the cited duration as a requirement or universal acceptance value."
    },
    {
      "id": "F005",
      "statement": "The Truck Home 2019 article contains an internal conflict about whether a non-independent refrigeration unit can operate when the vehicle engine is stopped.",
      "kind": "external_fact",
      "standard_related": false,
      "standard_assessment": "NOT_REGULATORY",
      "quantitative": false,
      "confidence": "CONFLICT",
      "scope": {
        "market": "CN",
        "model_year": "NOT_MODEL_SPECIFIC",
        "generation": "NON_MODEL_PROCUREMENT_METHOD",
        "trim": "FAMILY_OR_METHOD_ONLY",
        "powertrain": "NOT_SPECIFIED"
      },
      "source_ids": [
        "S1",
        "S2"
      ],
      "quotes": [
        {
          "source_id": "S1",
          "quote": "非独立制冷机组，就是机组本身没有动力装置，不能单独工作，必须要依靠发动机来带动压缩机进行工作。"
        },
        {
          "source_id": "S1",
          "quote": "非独立制冷机组更为合适，即使是在装卸货休息时发动机停止工作，制冷机组也可以正常工作。"
        },
        {
          "source_id": "S2",
          "quote": "非独立制冷机组是完全通过整车的发动机工作动力来带动机组的制冷工作。"
        }
      ],
      "checked_date": "2026-11-03",
      "buyer_applicability": "Do not use the conflicting engine-off statement as a fact. Obtain the offered unit's actual power-mode documentation and demonstration."
    },
    {
      "id": "F006",
      "statement": "Thermo King recommends matching refrigeration equipment to its exact application and notes that under- or over-specified equipment can waste fuel.",
      "kind": "external_fact",
      "standard_related": false,
      "standard_assessment": "NOT_REGULATORY",
      "quantitative": false,
      "confidence": "VERIFIED",
      "scope": {
        "market": "MANUFACTURER_METHOD_EXAMPLE",
        "model_year": "NOT_MODEL_SPECIFIC",
        "generation": "NON_MODEL_PROCUREMENT_METHOD",
        "trim": "FAMILY_OR_METHOD_ONLY",
        "powertrain": "NOT_SPECIFIED"
      },
      "source_ids": [
        "S5"

      "quotes": [
        {
          "source_id": "S5",
          "quote": "Match the equipment to the exact application it’s going to be used for."
        },
        {
          "source_id": "S5",
          "quote": "both under- and over-specified equipment can lead to fuel waste."
        }
      ],
      "checked_date": "2026-11-03",
      "buyer_applicability": "Attribute this recommendation to Thermo King. It supports asking whether the proposed equipment matches the stated application, not a fuel-savings estimate or approval of a particular truck."

    {
      "id": "F007",
      "statement": "Thermo King recommends considering airflow, pre-cooled goods and door-opening frequency when managing temperature in its truck and trailer refrigeration context.",
      "kind": "external_fact",
      "standard_related": false,
      "standard_assessment": "NOT_REGULATORY",
      "quantitative": false,
      "confidence": "VERIFIED",
      "scope": {
        "market": "MANUFACTURER_METHOD_EXAMPLE",
        "model_year": "NOT_MODEL_SPECIFIC",
        "generation": "NON_MODEL_PROCUREMENT_METHOD",
        "trim": "FAMILY_OR_METHOD_ONLY",
        "powertrain": "NOT_SPECIFIED"

      "source_ids": [
        "S5"
      ],
      "quotes": [
        {
          "source_id": "S5",
          "quote": "load vehicles in a way that helps avoid blocking the airflow around the cargo"
        },
        {
          "source_id": "S5",
          "quote": "loading all goods in a fully pre-cooled condition that is catered to the required set-point"
        },
        {
          "source_id": "S5",
          "quote": "by reducing the frequency and duration of door openings"
        }
      ],
      "checked_date": "2026-11-03",
      "buyer_applicability": "Attribute these as Thermo King's operating recommendations. They may inform questions for a demonstration but do not define a universal cargo test or pass/fail limit."

      "statement": "FUSO's European bodybuilder-portal description says it provides bodybuilders with technical drawings, wiring diagrams, specifications and guidelines for Canter and eCanter chassis.",

          "source_id": "S6",
          "quote": "Within its bodybuilder portal, FUSO provides all the information and data that a bodybuilder needs when planning for his customer on and with a Canter or eCanter chassis."
        },
        {
          "source_id": "S6",
          "quote": "The portal contains, among other things, technical drawings, wiring diagrams, specifications and guidelines"

      ],
      "checked_date": "2026-11-03",
      "buyer_applicability": "A Europe-scoped FUSO example only. It does not establish that another manufacturer offers equivalent documentation or that FUSO documentation applies to a different chassis."
    }
